S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No. 816 of 2024  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Gaurav Singh, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. V.K. Jemini, learned Dy. Advocate General with Mr. Sandeep Sharma, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. The present applicant is facing trial for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 452, 376(3)
and 506 IPC and under Section 5(m)/6 of POCSO Act in Special Session Trial No. 05 of 2023, State vs. Abhishek @ Banesh, pending in the Court of F.T.C/Additional Sessions Judge (POSO),
Haridwar.
4.

entities.text:
Court of F.T.C/Additional Sessions Judge (POSO),
Haridwar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that an opportunity to cross- examine PW6 Sajid Kamal, Principal, Government Higher Primary School, Sultanpur, Sabatwali, Roorkee, District Haridwar, was closed by the Trial Court on 12.02.2023.
Thereafter, an application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. was moved for recalling the said witness but the same was rejected.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that in fact PW6 is a very material witness, and, therefore, his cross-examination is necessary and that opportunity was closed merely on the basis that the counsel who is representing the applicant has not put his signature on the adjournment application.
5.
Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that for substantial justice, the applicant should be permitted to cross- examine PW6.

6. Mr. V.K. Jemini, learned Dy. Advocate General for the State has not seriously opposed the application but he submits that only one opportunity be given to the applicant to cross-examine Pw6.
7.

After taking into consideration all these aspect and arguments as advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, and further taking into consideration that the applicant is facing trial in respect of C482/816/2024 on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73415109/
1 offences punishable under Sections 323, 452, 376(3) and 506 IPC and under Section 5(m)/6 of POCSO Act and PW6 appears to be a material witness, who is required to be cross-examined to ascertain the age of the victim, this petition is being disposed of finally with a direction to the Trial Court to give one opportunity to the applicant to cross-examine PW6 by fixing a particular date.
8.
It is made clear that if the applicant fail to cross-examine PW6 on the date fixed then no further opportunity shall be granted to him.
9. In view of the aforesaid direction the present C482 application is disposed of finally.

(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 15.05.2024 Parul C482/816/2024 on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73415109/
